<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the only peaks in the typical aromatic region are at 143.85 ppm (quaternary aromatic carbon) and 130.30 ppm (aromatic CH carbon). This pattern corresponds to a para‑disubstituted benzene ring, which contains four aromatic carbons (two equivalent CH carbons and two equivalent quaternary carbons). Therefore, the molecule has 4 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
